transcription.note: Per-item params/jacks (paramsJackTargets.params[]/.endpoints[]) are a dedicated transcript pass (this file). Endpoint direction is the panel/prose signal direction; a jack whose direction is not literally stated is 'provisional'. 'patchable'=true means a real front-panel jack the user can virtual-cable; 'patchable'=false means a fixed internal (non-UI-patchable) endpoint owned by a module or a 'terminal' (ext_in/piezzo/distortion/out). Fixed topology is frozen HERE in P0 (Codex constraint #2): the complete audio chain (drone voices+EXT+VCO A/B+PREAMP -> 10ch MIX/PAN -> DUAL VCF L/R -> DISTORTION L/R -> DUAL EFFECTOR L/R -> WET OUT L/R) plus VCO dry bypases and the DRONE KEYS->GATE->VOICEs & PIEZZO->PREAMP->ENV-FOLLOWER control edges are enumerated edge-by-edge in target.fixedRoutes[], never as a grouped summary. Program names are VERBATIM from the manual cartridge pages (p23/p24), including the typo'd 'Resonance Reveb' and the 'HP/LP filter'/'Notch filter'/'Resonance flanger'/'Reverse Pitch delay'/'Bell pitchdelay' forms; ORCHE prints all three 'Program 1:' lines identically (p24 L1306), so slots 2/3 are recorded as a reasonable interpretation and marked PROVISIONAL, not confirmed. Primary evidence for programs is the manual (p23/p24); design/01 §4/design/05 are auxiliary only, never independently primary.

Codex msg c7089521: parameters carry an explicit shape/cardinality/recordType/maskSize; actions[] gives the event-only widgets a stable identity; migrationAllowlist grandfathers pre-correction rogues (always-on no-new-rogue). Fixed internal endpoints are independent of patchable jacks.

landedDescriptorFacts.note: Closed identity/evidence facts for the Phase B mods-gap slice (Codex msg 17cc9a4a). Their presence IS the declaration that these params/jacks have landed, so a registry missing one fails NORMAL rather than reopening a gap. descriptorEvidence.line is at WIDGET granularity (matching the per-widget evidence.line the registry cites); the parent region-span `evidence` is untouched. fieldEvidence is the 8-key exact projection of the same fields.

landedRouteFacts.note: Registry-specific identity/evidence facts for the 6 landed normalized routes (Codex msg b527ef3b / f2868b6b). source/sink/status are NOT duplicated here: target.normalizedRoutes is their single authority, and the checker exact-compares the actual route against it. landedRouteFacts holds ONLY what normalizedRoutes does not: numeric `id` plus a widget-granularity descriptorEvidence {ref, line}. descriptorEvidence.ref must equal the target route evidence ref, and descriptorEvidence.line must fall inside the target span. The facts key-set must equal the present (landed) route set, so dropping a fact is a hard fail. route.keyboard_gate_to_eg_b landed with envelope_b (Codex msg c4e6c0ff), provisional status.

landedModuleFacts.note: Single-authority module identity gate (Codex msg c4e6c0ff). target.modules is the authoritative source for name/category/status/evidence of every landed module; landedModuleFacts holds ONLY the numeric `id`, because the registry descriptor carries the identity but not a separately-authoritative copy. The facts key-set must EXACTLY equal the present (landed) module set: dropping a fact is a hard fail, and a module the registry contains that has no fact is also a hard fail (no new module can land without an id fact). The checker exact-compares the actual module's id to the fact and its name/category/status/evidence to target.modules, so a renumber or any identity drift is caught.

migrationAllowlist.note: Permanently-empty migration allowlist. Migration is complete and it is LOCKED EMPTY (Codex msg 064cfa6e): never computed from the implementation, so the manifest does not reverse-depend on lunar24.json and stays a one-way target->overlay source. Any registry param/jack not in the target is a NEW rogue and fails the always-on gate; the legacy ceiling backstop also forbids re-whitelisting a re-introduced pre-correction id outside the target.
